test_run_test: test the BaseTestGptOss.run_test method to launch a GPT-OSS model with a given variant and quantization
test_run_test_raw: test the BaseTestGptOss._run_test_raw method to launch a model server and run GPQA evaluations
test_check_streaming_responses_api_reque: test the BaseTestGptOss._check_streaming_responses_api_request method to verify SSE streaming responses from the /v1/responses endpoint
test_run_one_eval: test the BaseTestGptOss._run_one_eval method to run a single GPQA evaluation with a specified reasoning effort level
run_eval_gpqa: run the run_eval function from sglang.test.run_eval to evaluate a model on the GPQA benchmark
